verdict.rationale: Obsidian's first-party docs describe the Obsidian URI, a custom protocol that triggers actions such as opening or creating a note. That squarely covers driving the app from outside via a URI scheme or deep link for scripts and workflows. The evidence is a single summary line, though, with no detail on parameters or on how far automation can go. missing for 10: documented URI action and parameter list, any local HTTP/API endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of URI-based automation.
